payload.title: App-author SDK: harvest reusable framework glue from Zavro
payload.description:
Zavro (the multi-tenant field-service platform built on Frick, at ~/dev/aquariusyacht) has accreted a layer of code that is pure Frick-app plumbing — not Zavro business logic and not marine-specific. Every future Frick app will re-derive the same glue. This epic harvests it down into Frick so apps get it for free.

Provenance: identified in a Zavro architecture review (2026-06-06). Each child story cites the reference implementation by path in ~/dev/aquariusyacht so a Frick agent can lift + generalize it. The test is strict: only code with NO Zavro/marine business concept belongs here. Excluded on purpose (these are Zavro the product, not framework): the entitlements/marketplace catalog, the per-vertical terminology engine, and the app role taxonomy.

Children cross-link to the topical epics they touch (FR-6 tenancy, FR-9 blobs, FR-5 auth).
